content:
tara: quick heads-up — onboarding playkit e2e failing when exercising the embed + chat flow, looks like duplicate token charges on intermittent 429s

aditya: can you paste the failing log + repro steps?

tara: steps: clone playkit, set REDWOOD_API_KEY, run `yarn dev` then run `yarn test:e2e:embed` (local chrome). repro is flaky but happened 3x in last 2 runs. log excerpt below:
```
2026-03-23T14:02:03.112Z ERROR embed-worker request failed status=429 body=\"Too Many Requests\"
2026-03-23T14:02:03.113Z INFO embed-worker retrying request attempt=1
2026-03-23T14:02:03.214Z ERROR embed-worker request failed status=429 body=\"Too Many Requests\"
2026-03-23T14:02:03.215Z INFO embed-worker giving up, forwarding to app
2026-03-23T14:02:03.216Z INFO app sending 2 embed requests for same doc id=abc123 (duplicate)
```

tara: minimal repro snippet from playkit (JS SDK):
```js
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference-js'
const c = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
await Promise.all([c.embeddings.create({ input: 'doc1' }), c.embeddings.create({ input: 'doc1' })])
```

marta: hmm — are we seeing the JS SDK doing automatic retry while the Python/LLM harness avoids retries, so the app side replays?

aditya: that'd explain doubled requests — but our JS SDK should be idempotent for non-GETs if an idempotency key is provided. Playkit doesn't pass one.

sam: quick note: LangChain/LLamaIndex integrations call the API from synchronous flows and sometimes re-run on exceptions. If the SDK retries + the app retries, you get 2+ attempts. Need a guard at SDK or starter level.

ci-bot: test-run/playkit-e2e failed — job=playkit-e2e runner=ubuntu-22 image=chrome-headless exit=1

lucas: I can add a small fix: starter should set a default idempotency header on client init (optional opt-out) and e2e should assert no duplicate embed calls per doc id. Also add a flaky-tolerant backoff in JS SDK to avoid immediate double retries.

aditya: agreed. two-pr plan: (1) patch playkit to use idempotency keys + middleware that dedupes concurrent identical requests, (2) patch JS SDK to expose retry/backoff parity with python and opt-in idempotency header. Add an e2e test that asserts token count doesn't regress.

marta: small workaround for now: set REDWOOD_CLIENT_IDEMPOTENCY=\"on\" in .env and pin @redwood/inference-js to 1.2.3 which has the dedupe middleware. Add note in README.

tara: can someone own the SDK ticket? assigning to lucas for the starter + e2e, aditya to coordinate SDK parity. I'll file the eval/regression alert to watch token/unit cost.

lucas: taking starter + e2e. I'll open PR with tests + demo of idempotency header by EOD.

aditya: I'll scope SDK changes — add feature flag, docs, and a migration note. also adding an automated smoke eval in CI to detect >1.1x token cost increase for common sample flows.

sam: note for docs team — update onboarding quickstart to recommend idempotency header when doing concurrent writes (embedding/indexing).

ci-bot: build/playkit-e2e job queued -> rerun on PR  (via github/actions) :rocket:

tara: excellent — thanks everyone. tagging @marta for docs follow-up and @sam for langchain/llamaindex guidance. will close thread when PRs land. :thumbsup:
